labels.MEASURED: Counted or timed on our own system, on the date shown.
labels.REPRODUCED: Measured, then repeated on a second run with the same result.
labels.MODELLED: Computed from measured inputs under stated assumptions. A scenario, not a result.
labels.ESTIMATE: A reasoned figure with a published method and a range.
labels.FORECAST: What we expect, with no result behind it yet.
labels.EXAMPLE: An illustration. Not a record of any real client.
labels.UNKNOWN: We have not measured this yet, so we do not show a number.

loop.name: Work
loop.text: A job runs and leaves a record.

loop.name: Measure
loop.text: We count what it cost and how long it took.

loop.name: Find waste
loop.text: We look for the part that did not need to happen.

loop.name: Turn the lesson into code
loop.text: A fix becomes a test so the mistake cannot return quietly.

loop.name: Re-run
loop.text: The same job runs again on the improved system.

loop.name: Lower the cost
loop.text: The new cost is measured against the old one.

loop.name: More work
loop.text: The saving buys more jobs, and the loop turns again.
